questions.question: What does a unit test check?
options: One small piece of code, such as a method, in isolation
The whole system running on a production server
The look of the web page
questions.explanation: A unit test runs a single small piece of code and compares its result with an expected value.

questions.question: What does @BeforeEach do in a JUnit test class?
options: Runs once before the whole class
questions.explanation: @BeforeEach runs before every single test, so each test starts with fresh data.

questions.question: A @ParameterizedTest uses @CsvSource with 4 rows. How many test executions does Maven report for it?
questions.explanation: The test method runs once for each row of the source, so four rows give four executions.

questions.question: A test has assertEquals(300, pricer.price(30, false)) but the method returns 200. What does the failure message say?
questions.explanation: assertEquals puts the expected value first, so it reports expected 300 but was 200.

questions.question: A test method is written as public void check() with no annotation on it. Maven reports 0 tests run for the class. What is missing?
options: The word Test at the start of the method name
questions.explanation: JUnit only runs methods marked with @Test, so an unmarked method is silently ignored.
